briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race amid compute bottlenecks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as multiple labs push multi-trillion parameter models. US-China compute export controls tighten while safety incidents rise in deployed agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 compete closely. Meta and xAI open-sourced larger models while DeepSeek R2 hits top benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and TSMC 2nm delays create shortages. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters in Q3 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory caps on training runs slow the US lead or accelerate Chinese domestic chip innovation?
